title: SecretPattern
description: A named secret pattern for the secrets scanner (§18). Each pattern has a unique identifier, a human-readable name, a severity level, and one or more regular expressions that match secrets of this type.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for this pattern (e.g., 'anthropic_api_key'). Used as the canonical identifier across client and backend.

name.description: Human-readable name for this pattern type (e.g., 'AWS Access Key').

severity.description: Severity level: high, medium, or low.

patterns.description: Regular expressions that match this secret type. Multiple patterns are OR'd together.
